subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable-runtime stack and define `delivered` as successful generation-fenced ownership transfer to the internal session delivery queue on the 2026.7.1 release line?
rationale: The branch introduces a broad core runtime, persistent schema, protocol and SDK surfaces, environment switches, and new session-delivery semantics; code review cannot determine whether that product and release direction is sponsored.

options.title: Sponsor staged landing
options.body: Confirm the durable-core direction, require dependencies to land in order, pin the CI tool, and obtain current-head upgrade and live queue proof before merging this slice.

options.title: Narrow and retarget
options.body: Move the focused PR5 handoff onto a clean branch after the prerequisite durable PRs land, excluding cumulative and unrelated CI changes.

options.title: Defer durable core
options.body: Pause or close the stack until maintainers choose a different durable-runtime architecture or release window.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged landing
recommendation.body: Confirm the durable-core direction, require dependencies to land in order, pin the CI tool, and obtain current-head upgrade and live queue proof before merging this slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent gateway and session-recovery work is the closest available ownership signal for deciding the internal delivery and restart contract.
